status: construction-plan input; not a mesh, admission, collider, or runtime approval

asset.intendedRole: A grounded near-camera Rootbound frame/counterweight. It supports the Lantern Hollow / Thornstone circuit without becoming a hero landmark, traversal feature, or asset family.

runtimeBudget.material: one opaque matte material; vertex-color or palette variation is permitted within it
runtimeBudget.collision: separate compact lower-mass proposal only; crown and outer root tips do not imply collision

sources.provenance: built-in OpenAI image generation; backend undisclosed
sources.factsOnly: Opaque white background, one complete tree, warm faceted trunk/root mass, three separated green canopy lobes.

bindingFindings: Three to five broad grounded buttresses must form a closed lower root base.
Preserve visible trunk-to-major-branch junctions and the three-lobe asymmetric frame.
Do not model hundreds of leaves, leaf cards, a fused opaque crown, or walk-under root arches.
Neutral all-side, ground-contact, 48 px, 96 px, and frozen portrait-camera evidence remains required before admission.

sources.kind: numerical foreground-bounds corroboration; no image editing or derived image
bindingFindings: Across three threshold rows, the target foreground bounds measure 1,149 px wide by 1,198–1,199 px high.
The projected height-to-width ratio is 1.0426–1.0435, so the complete visible silhouette is approximately 1:1, not 1.7:1.
These are screen-space bounds only and do not recover a camera, depth, rear form, or mesh topology.
The asset is one authorized static Rootbound anchor, not a Heartroot Crown or a new biome kit.
It must retain a compact lower-mass collider and existing route, forage, and wildlife clearances.
The Lantern Hollow composition still requires an open center lane and opposing existing edge clusters; this tree cannot substitute for them.

cameraAndMeasurementLimits.referenceCamera: Perspective three-quarter view; focal length, roll, distance, exact depth, rear topology, and hidden junction geometry are unknown.
cameraAndMeasurementLimits.coordinateConventionForPlan: Normalized image coordinates have origin at the target image's upper-left, x increases right, y increases down. Builder dimensions use Blender meters, X width, Y depth, Z up.
cameraAndMeasurementLimits.reliability: Visible-front silhouette proportions and landmarks are observations; numerical foreground bounds corroborate a roughly 1:1 projected height-to-width silhouette. All depth, rear construction, exact thickness, topology, and physical fork-window size are declared design inferences.

prohibitions: Do not reuse any geometry, topology, source scene, render, or export from rootbound-buttress-v1 candidate-v1, candidate-v2, or candidate-v3.
Do not use TRELLIS, image-to-3D, Blender runtime integration, or a generic tree generator as the final construction method.
Do not add transparent foliage, leaf cards, wind, glow, a second material, a broad canopy collider, roots that create tunnels, or new gameplay behavior.
requiredEvidenceBeforeAnyAdmission: Fresh editable source and fresh neutral front, rear, left, right, and three-quarter renders from the constructed mesh.
Untextured massing proof before final faceting; all branch/root attachments visible from more than the source-facing view.
Measured exported bounds, triangle count, material count, orientation, ground contacts, and compact collider parity.
48 px and 96 px game-scale frames plus a normal frozen Destination portrait frame.
Independent model review and separate runtime/placement review.
